title: Whoa / animated typographic texture

location.extent: Complete published clip; PNG is a frame at 0.5 seconds

slide_intent: Show variation through repetition because changing letter width and weight can make a phrase visually energetic.
strategic_value: An all-type surface can convey creative energy without additional illustration.
demonstration: Rows of orange-red Whoa specimens shift between narrow, broad, light and heavy forms on a pale portrait field.
practical_value: Assess how dense typographic repetition changes emphasis as individual words expand.

content_islands.name: Repeated word field
content_islands.spec: Fill the portrait with aligned rows of the same word in varied proportions.

content_islands.name: Animated emphasis
content_islands.spec: Observe which specimens widen or thicken over the complete loop.
